lints.name: e_subject_common_name_max_length

lints.name: e_subject_common_name_not_from_san
lints.description: The common name field in subscriber certificates must include only names from the SAN extension

lints.name: e_subject_contains_noninformational_value

lints.description: If a subject organization name is absent then an organizational unit name MUST NOT be included in subject

lints.name: e_subject_country_name

lints.name: e_subject_country_not_iso

lints.name: e_subject_dn_serial_number_not_printable_string
lints.description: X520 Distinguished Name SerialNumber MUST be encoded as PrintableString

lints.name: e_subject_locality_name_max_length

lints.name: e_subject_organizational_unit_name_max_length
lints.description: The 'Organizational Unit Name' field of the subject MUST be less than 65 characters

lints.name: e_subject_postal_code_max_length
lints.description: The 'PostalCode' field of the subject MUST be less than 17 characters

lints.name: e_subject_printable_string_badalpha
lints.description: PrintableString type's alphabet only includes a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and 11 special characters

lints.name: e_subject_state_name_max_length

lints.name: e_subject_street_address_max_length
lints.description: The 'StreetAddress' field of the subject MUST be less than 129 characters

lints.name: e_subject_surname_max_length
lints.description: The 'Surname' field of the subject MUST be less than 32769 characters

lints.description: cRLDistributionPoints SHALL have URI scheme HTTP.

lints.name: e_subscribers_shall_have_crl_distribution_points
lints.description: cRLDistributionPoints SHALL be present.

lints.name: e_superfluous_ku_encoding
lints.description: RFC 5280 Section 4.2.1.3 describes the value of a KeyUsage to be a DER encoded BitString, which itself must not have unnecessary trailing 00 bytes.
lints.citation: 1.2.2 Where Rec. ITU-T X.680 | ISO/IEC 8824-1, 22.7, applies, the bitstring shall have all trailing 0 bits removed before it is encoded.

lints.name: e_tbs_signature_rsa_encryption_parameter_not_null
lints.description: RSA: Encoded signature algorithm identifier MUST have NULL parameters

lints.name: e_this_update_not_after_produced_at
lints.description: The value of thisUpdate MUST be prior to the time at which the response is produced, i.e., the value of producedAt
lints.details: OCSP lint: only applicable to an OCSP response, not to a certificate

lints.name: e_tls_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_398_days
lints.description: TLS server certificates issued on or after September 1, 2020 00:00 GMT/UTC must not have a validity period greater than 398 days

lints.name: e_underscore_not_permissible_in_dnsname
lints.description: DNSNames MUST NOT contain underscore characters

lints.name: e_underscore_present_with_too_long_validity
lints.description: From 2018-12-10 to 2019-04-01, DNSNames may contain underscores if-and-only-if the certificate is valid for less than thirty days.

lints.name: e_utc_time_does_not_include_seconds
lints.description: UTCTime values MUST include seconds

lints.description: UTCTime values MUST be expressed in Greenwich Mean Time (Zulu)

lints.description: Certificates valid through the year 2049 MUST be encoded in UTC time

lints.name: n_san_dns_name_duplicate

lints.name: n_san_iana_pub_suffix_empty

lints.description: Subordinate CA extkeyUsage, either id-kp-serverAuth or id-kp-clientAuth or both values MUST be present to be technically constrained.

lints.name: n_subject_common_name_included

lints.description: For certificates with ECC public keys the keyAgreement key usage is allowed and not recommended.

lints.description: The key usage extension should use specific key usage settings for ETSI certificates issued to natural persons

lints.description: When the id-ad-caIssuers accessMethod is used, at least one instance SHOULD specify an accessLocation that is an HTTP or LDAP URI

lints.name: w_ext_cert_policy_contains_noticeref

lints.name: w_ext_crl_distribution_marked_critical

lints.name: w_ext_ian_critical

lints.name: w_ext_key_usage_not_critical

lints.name: w_ext_policy_map_not_critical

lints.name: w_ext_san_critical_with_subject_dn

lints.name: w_ext_subject_key_identifier_missing_sub_cert

lints.name: w_issuer_dn_trailing_whitespace
